Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionCollect the crystals and reclaim your future as you survive bullet hell mayhem in a post-apocalyptic world! Shockwave Triggers is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up where you’ll choose between 2 pilots – the fast and versatile Amira, whose crystal-sensitive sister has been kidnapped, and the slower but more powerful Turbo B, a mechanic determined to take down the supreme leader of the WW army! Enjoy anime-style cutscenes and a pumping soundtrack as you blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem. Collect crystals from destroyed enemies, initiate shockwaves to cancel incoming projectiles into gems, deploy super attacks and upgrade your ship with character-specific armaments! Use the shop system to earn new features or buy extra credits, choose from multiple difficulties to suit your playstyle, fill your gallery with unlockable art and use the jukebox feature to enjoy the game’s original soundtrack.
